descriptions.text: Toad Cudgel. Big stick for bonking. Bonk toad. Bonk mob. Bonk girlfriend and drag back to cave by hair.

beats.headline: A stick, from a weapon box
beats.text: Carl's loot boxes open by tier, one after another. The third is a Bronze Weapon Box, and the label over its prize reads Toad Cudgel. The toad cudgel is a stick. It looks like a three-quarter-length baseball bat shaped by someone who only had a vague idea of what baseball was. The box after it is another weapon box, and the fireplace poker inside is not much better.

beats.headline: Big stick for bonking
beats.text: While the cat is still inside her blob, Carl looks over the rest of his loot and puts the fingerless gloves on. Of the two weapons he likes the feel of the cudgel more than the poker, which feels like it would bend and break the moment he hit something. The AI describes the cudgel in a caveman voice. He wonders whether the metal pot is still out there. It would be better than this.

beats.headline: Bounced off a roach
beats.text: Carl knows he does less damage this way than with his hands, but he does not want to fight a level-four brood guardian bare-handed, so he pulls the toad cudgel while Donut hits the roach with three magic missiles. When it charges again he swings the cudgel down at its head. The rounded edge bounces off, the bug hisses and falls back, and the hit doesn't appear to do much. He has to bend awkwardly to use it, too, and he switches to the poker to see if that is better.
